grammar.pattern: 马上 / 先 / 有时 · 在 / 正 / 正在
grammar.purpose: Place timing words before the action
grammar.explanation: 马上 says right away; 先 marks what happens first; 有时/有时候 means sometimes. Put these before the main verb, after the subject. 在/正/正在 can mark an ongoing action. Compare 我在家 (location) with 我在读书 (ongoing action). The two meanings of 在 have different complements.

examples.py: wǒ mǎ shàng dǎ kāi diàn nǎo .
examples.en: I will turn on the computer right away.

examples.py: nǐ xiān dú kè wén , wǒ zài dú .
examples.en: Read the lesson text first; I will read afterwards.

commonMistakes.why: Put 马上 before the verb phrase 打开电脑.

grammar.pattern: 在 / 正在 + verb · 在 / 正 / 正在 + verb + 呢 · action + 呢
grammar.explanation: Use 在 or 正在 before an action verb to emphasize that it is happening now. 呢 may close the sentence; with clear context it can carry the ongoing meaning without 在: 我读书呢. 正 commonly pairs with 呢. These patterns do not make all verbs progressive: states such as 有 normally do not use 正在. A question can ask 你在干什么？

dialogue.title: A voice message at the wrong moment
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 你现在忙吗？在干什么？
lines.py: nǐ xiàn zài máng ma ? zài gàn shén me ?
lines.en: Are you busy now? What are you doing?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我正在读书呢，先不说话。
lines.py: wǒ zhèng zài dú shū ne , xiān bù shuō huà .
lines.en: I am reading right now, so I will not talk yet.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，我马上关电脑。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ mǎ shàng guān diàn nǎo .
lines.en: Okay, I will turn off the computer right away.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不用。你先上网找课文。
lines.py: bù yòng . nǐ xiān shàng wǎng zhǎo kè wén .
lines.en: No need. Go online and find the lesson text first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你有时候读书，有时候上网，是吗？
lines.py: nǐ yǒu shí hou dú shū , yǒu shí hou shàng wǎng , shì ma ?
lines.en: Sometimes you read and sometimes you go online, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。我正读课文呢。
lines.py: duì . wǒ zhèng dú kè wén ne .
lines.en: Yes. I am reading the lesson text right now.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我打开电脑了，现在做什么？
lines.py: wǒ dǎ kāi diàn nǎo le , xiàn zài zuò shén me ?
lines.en: I turned on the computer. What should I do now?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先看这个动作，不要动。
lines.py: xiān kàn zhè gè dòng zuò , bú yào dòng .
lines.en: Watch this movement first; do not move yet.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这个动作很慢，我看清楚了。
lines.py: zhè gè dòng zuò hěn màn , wǒ kàn qīng chǔ le .
lines.en: This movement is slow; I can see it clearly.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，关上门，再大声读。
lines.py: hǎo , guān shang mén , zài dà shēng dú .
lines.en: Good. Shut the door, then read aloud.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我在读呢。你能听到吗？
lines.py: wǒ zài dú ne . nǐ néng tīng dào ma ?
lines.en: I am reading. Can you hear?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 能听到。读完再回消息，不着急。
lines.py: néng tīng dào . dú wán zài huí xiāo xī , bù zháo jí .
lines.en: Yes. Reply to the message after reading; there is no rush.
lines.speaker: b

notes: AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 一11, 一42. Native check: voice-message context, progressive 呢 without 在, and clipped original verse rhythm.
